answer: Each challenge is derived from a threshold-BLS drand pulse published only after an agent commits, so its unpredictable value binds the task to a future round rather than a reusable prompt. A reveal must match that commitment and the pulse-derived challenge, limiting advance computation and making mass offline farming by sybil swarms costly, though not impossible. The glacier, river, and trellis labels can domain-separate task classes without weakening beacon unpredictability.
